description.value: Structural Sense extends to sense structural danger anywhere on your current level or floor, not just nearby.

cinderfall.incomplete: Structural Sense's real shape is a toggleable Perception FlatModifier, not a Sense; 'sense structural danger anywhere on your current level or floor' would need a Sense selector, and no matching sense type exists for structural-hazard detection in pf2e's SENSE_TYPES enum.
